rationale: dual_domain-claude-agentic: epochs=15, lr=0.0005, batch_size=1, unet_c=8, train_n=50, val_n=5, rationale=iter-3: KNOB=unet_c: 24→8 + ep 8→15 + lr 5e-5→5e-4. iter-1 (c=16) iter-2 (c=24) both stuck at SSIM~0.46. Hypothesis: maybe N2I needs LESS capacity (c=8, very lightweight) so it can't overfit to noise floor, but MORE epochs at HIGHER lr to converge. Architecturally distinct from prior iters.
